title: horizon --hook stays under its limit whatever a gate's question length
goal: backlog.py horizon --hook shortens each waiting gate's question and recommendation so the hook output stays under test_backlog's HOOK_LIMIT for any gate text; a test plants a gate with a 1500-character question and the hook output stays under the limit
notes: On 2026-10-01 a worker gate on ST-nesccqgl with a long question made the repository hook output 1912 characters and test_horizon_hook_of_the_repository_backlog_stays_under_the_limit failed in the sync gate of TK-cjoc2gm4 until the gate was answered.
